headline: WordPress vs Custom Website 2026
description: WordPress or a custom-built website? Answer 5 questions in our interactive tool and get an honest recommendation — from a team that builds both.

itemListElement.name: WordPress vs Custom Website in 2026: Which Should You Build?

mainEntity.name: Is WordPress good enough for a professional business website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — over 40% of the web runs on it, including major brands. Quality depends on who builds and configures it, not the platform itself.

mainEntity.name: Is WordPress cheaper than a custom website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Substantially. In India, a professional WordPress site typically runs ₹30,000–₹2,00,000 versus ₹3,00,000–₹20,00,000+ for custom development. The gap widens further with ongoing maintenance.

mainEntity.name: Can WordPress handle e-commerce in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — WooCommerce with an Indian payment gateway (Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree) handles catalogues, payments, shipping and GST invoicing well for standard stores. Very large or unusual stores may outgrow it.

mainEntity.name: When should I NOT use WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: When the website is itself the product — user dashboards, marketplaces, SaaS tools, real-time features — or when a mobile app sharing the same backend is on the roadmap. That's custom (or hybrid) territory.
Yes — we ship both WordPress websites and custom MERN/React Native products, which is why our recommendation isn't biased toward one hammer.
